entries.name: Laguna Loire
entries.sourceReference: Final Fantasy VIII (1999), Laguna Loire — Desperado Limit Break: thrown grenade and one-handed machine-gun fire while hanging from a rope.

visualValidation.notes: Local blue jacket, white undershirt, brown trousers, gloves, black boots and long dark hair retained. Desperado is rope-hanging grenade/machine-gun fire; the rope has a short visible upper end entirely inside each cell, without invented grappling hardware. Only the four finale poses use a separate native correction: one-handed rope suspension, grenade throw, machine-gun bursts and release/landing. The seven other phase rows, including the original Desperado super, retain exactly their original RGBA pixels and hashes.
visualValidation.reviewMethod: Native source atlas and normalized contact-sheet visual inspection for all 32 poses, costume, weapon and non-gory support/finishing choreography.

correctionReview.reason: The original finale row depicted standing gunfire despite its named Desperado suspension script.

entries.name: Selphie Tilmitt
entries.sourceReference: Final Fantasy VIII (1999), Selphie Tilmitt — The End, résultat de Slot qui termine le combat et élimine les ennemis : calme visuel d’une conclusion en prairie/fleurs, sans gore ; effet offensif et résultat conservés par le moteur.

visualValidation.notes: Original youthful appearance, brown outward-flipped bob, modest yellow sleeveless zipped dress and brown boots retained. Calme visuel d’une conclusion en prairie/fleurs, sans gore ; The End élimine les ennemis et son effet offensif/résultat reste conservé par le moteur. Ce rendu visuel ne transforme pas The End en soin ni en buff.
visualValidation.reviewMethod: Native source atlas and normalized contact-sheet visual inspection for all 32 poses, costume, weapon and non-gory narrative conclusion. The End’s calm meadow/flower imagery does not change its offensive combat-ending result.
